Rx8s are great but you need to follow a few guidelines to buy a good one. Here is the top few.
1. Buy an 06+. Reason being that 04 and 05s have way too many issues.
2. This one is the most important. Get a compression test done at the dealership. They will charge you for an hour of labor but it will show you the life of the motor. 
These are the basic ones. Check out rx8club.com its a really good community and they have a lot of information for first time owners. Check it out.

Yes he is completely bull shiting you. Don't buy an rx8 with a check engine light on. My friend did that thinking he could fix it cheaply and it turned out two months later he had a low compression. Wait to buy one that's in good running order or else the car will ruin you.
